title: LesionMix: A Lesion-Level Data Augmentation Method for Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Lesion-level augmentation that controls lesion load distribution, shape, location and intensity, both populating and inpainting lesions.
adaptation: Unify paste (Soft-CP / CarveMix) and removal (GDI) under per-source load sampling: per cell, sample crack component count and inactive area from the train distribution of its source and add or remove to reach it.
min_experiment: Best of GDI / CarveMix / Soft-CP arms with vs without load control; kill < +0.01 on that arm's metric.
evidence: Outperforms recent Mix-based augmentations on 4 brain MR and 1 liver CT lesion datasets (abstract; no numbers read).
